title: State wage decisions naming a San Francisco public project
question: Has the State found workers underpaid on San Francisco public works?
finding: Of 289 published State decisions on prevailing-wage assessments since 2011, 3 concern a San Francisco project: two against Shamrock Structures, Inc. affirming $101,352 in unpaid wages on two branch-library jobs for Public Works, and one penalty against East Bay Floorcovering, Inc. that the State dismissed.
how: The text of every decision on the Department of Industrial Relations’ list was searched for San Francisco public bodies; a decision is kept when its project or awarding-body sentence names one. Two more mention San Francisco only in passing and are left out.
limits: Only assessments that a contractor appealed to the Director appear on this list; most wage cases settle earlier and are not published here. The State’s public-works contractor registry could not be downloaded, so subcontractor lists by project are missing. A dismissed assessment is a finding for the contractor.

rows.result: ORDER The Determination of Civil Penalty is dismissed as set forth in the above Findings.
The associated penalties assessed under section 1775 are therefore affirmed.
